digest.component_or_area: Complexity baseline wrapper and repository lint gate
propositions: Repository contains 69 live C901 over-threshold production functions (max score 45 in src/rebar) that must be bounded by an immutable baseline to prevent new/increased complexity regression while allowing shrink-only maintenance.

A shrink-only JSON baseline and guarded Python wrapper (check_complexity_baseline.py) enforce that current C901 scores never exceed recorded per-function ceilings, exit zero only when all findings are at-or-below baseline, and reject new or increased debt.

The wrapper accepts Ruff return codes 0 and 1 as normal diagnostic output after JSON validation, normalizes qualified function symbols from Python AST, and computes mutually exclusive active/new/increased/stale counters to determine exit status.
The --update-stale maintenance mode lowers/removes stale entries through atomic_write, refuses to write for new/increased debt or scanner errors, and leaves target unchanged on write failure.
Integration into make lint gates pre-commit and CI on the wrapper's exit code rather than raw Ruff, with complexity check scoped to production src/rebar while format/lint cover src and tests.
